description: AKTIVITETSRESULTAT with an SKS procedure aktivitetstype kode AND two blood pressure XML elements. Procedure-output must be preserved; XML elements are routed to Observation per SFI-element.

routing.rationale: Maaling-aktivitetstype routes to Observation. Procedure-output is a parallel emission triggered by is_sks_procedure_code, not by routing.

expected_procedure_output.note: Bevares som separat spor uafhaengigt af SFI-routing.

expected_sfi_datapoint_grouping_key: ifdb_aktivitet_id=1001 must yield exactly 2 rows in fhir.SFI_datapoint
notes: Procedure-output MUST remain. The SFI Observation path may NOT remove the is_sks_procedure_code emission.
All Observations must share ifdb_aktivitet_id=1001 so consumers can rejoin to the original XML.
